segments.source: 1. Noah and Owen are siblings because they share parent Maya. 2. Lina is child of Noah; Sara is child of Owen. 3. Children of siblings are cousins in this model.
Lina and Sara are cousins under the implied family tree.
Family relations can be derived step by step from a small set of explicit links.
Directed parent graph; kinship predicates derived from path length and shared ancestors.
Problem 186. Temporal compatibility in a story set in 1400
Anachronism can be tested as a compatibility problem when the relevant date ranges are supplied.

For this problem, availability intervals are: Technology A: 1200–1600; Institution B: 1500–1900; Tool C: 1700–2000; Practice D: 1300–1450. A story is set in 1400 and mentions Technology A and Tool C together.
An item is temporally compatible with a year only if the year lies inside its stated availability interval. An anachronism is an item placed outside its given interval.
Which mentioned item, if any, is anachronistic in the story?
1. Check 1400 against Technology A interval 1200–1600. 2. Check 1400 against Tool C interval 1700–2000. 3. Items outside their intervals: ['Tool C'].
The reasoning does not require memorizing invention dates if the intervals are part of the problem.
Interval membership test for each object-event pair.
